scope: Cancel pending browser review inputs at screen/ratio/focus changes while preserving completed actions.

reproducedBefore.formation: Hold occupied slot → home → wait 750ms: slot0 became empty and formation rendered under HOME caption.
reproducedBefore.growth: Hold upgrade → blur at ~500ms: level13 became17 during next550ms.

rules.summon: Cancel aim timer, preview and pointer capture on redraw/navigation/window blur/hidden; no echo cost.
rules.formation: Cancel active slot hold/drag before rendering another screen or ratio; no delayed removal/render.
rules.preset: Cancel uncommitted hold on screen/focus change or >8px movement; suppress accidental load after cancellation; valid600ms hold still saves.
rules.growth: Stop hold repeats on window blur/hidden/navigation; retain purchases completed before cancellation.
rules.resonance: Leaving pending confirmation closes it without consuming fragments.

unchanged.economy: local review only, no save or live game wallet

testLimit: Blur event is dispatched in headless browser to exercise cleanup. Actual app hide/restore, Unity pointer capture and device lifecycle still require Unity/device tests.
